tagline: Share files nearby. No internet needed.
brief: Free, open-source, ultra-lightweight, cross-platform local file sharing. An AirDrop-style experience for every device, built in the open.
criteria: Success: reads as drop + proximity at a glance, works at 16 px and in one colour, distinct from generic water/wifi icons.

concepts.name: Ripple Drop
concepts.idea: A drop at the centre of open ripples: files land on nearby devices, no internet in between.
rationale: Drop + concentric ripples = the name and the proximity idea in one shape
Rings are open at the top: open source, and the drop tip rises out
Two colours carry the name: navy 'drop', sea-teal 'umi' (umi = sea)
Dedicated small-size cut keeps it legible at 16 px

recommendation: Ripple Drop is the final merged direction: the Ripple and Radiate concepts combined.
next_steps: Drop files from branding/final into the app and website
Add favicon and web manifest from branding/final/web
